comparison.objective: Open three breaker terminals, insert one comb busbar into all terminals, then tighten every screw onto its pin.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated screwdriver strokes, multi-receiver preparation, simultaneous multi-pin insertion, and sequential clamping.
comparison.success_condition: All pins home with bar square, all screws tightened, assembly withstands a 10 N pull, tool and hands clear for two seconds.
comparison.reason: This tests preparatory loosening, multi-pin insertion, and rotary clamping. The candidate instead uses impact to remove sacrificial tangs while preserving existing inserts and collecting the freed pieces.
